title: SLU’s William L. Clay, Sr. Institute of Civic Engagement and Economic Justice to Hold Community Symposium
summary_en: Saint Louis University’s William L. Clay Sr. Institute of Civic Engagement and Economic Justice will host a community and civic engagement symposium on Wednesday, Nov. 11.
